current_activity: the 3d and 45th Divisions begin the assault on Nuremberg on 16 April
notes: Event date: 16 April 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 18 p. 424: the 3d and 45th Divisions "in two days spanned the thirty miles from Bamberg to the outskirts of Nuremberg and began an assault on the city on 16 April"; Wikipedia, Battle of Nuremberg (1945): by 16 April the Seventh Army had begun its assault from the east and northeast; CMH ETO-OB command-post list of the 45th Infantry Division: Lauf on 16 Apr 45). Event definition: the division attacks from the northeast on the first day of the battle; the command post at Lauf an der Pegnitz, about 15 km east-northeast of the city centre, is listed on the same day. Relationship: XV Corps unspecified_subordination (from 15 Mar 45 to 5 May 45, CMH table); Seventh Army assigned (from 15 Sep 44, CMH table); 6th Army Group assigned (from 15 Sep 44, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. The earlier unspecified_subordination relation to VI Corps (CR0293) is closed at 14 March 1945 (inferred_from_next_claim); see the Review note on it. Location: Lauf an der Pegnitz (CMH ETO-OB command-post list, R355 p. 184: listed 16 April 1945); the town centre stands for the command post. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Lauf an der Pegnitz. Event support: good (the Green Book, Wikipedia and the CMH table agree on the day). Location support: moderate (command post listed on the date).

current_activity: troops of the division fight room to room in the SS caserne on the northern edge of Munich as the city falls
notes: Event date: 30 April 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 18 p. 437: "Even as a big white streamer flew from the highest building in Munich, troops of the 45th Division were fighting from room to room in the SS caserne to dislodge die-hard defenders"; units of the 3d and 42d Divisions reached the centre of the city before midday on 30 April; CMH ETO-OB command-post list of the 45th Infantry Division: Feldmoching on 30 Apr 45).
